title: connect() with auto protocol classification on a canonical FeatureServer URL
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that uses the one-call connect() entry point from @honua/sdk-js: await connect({ endpoint: <HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL>/rest/services/EvalIncidents/FeatureServer/0, protocol: "auto", authorizationScopeFingerprint: "anonymous" }). auto works offline here because the URL matches the canonical GeoServices layout. Take connection.source() (exactly one source is discovered) and run source.query({ where: "1=1" }). Print exactly one line to stdout: {"count": <result.features.length>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: fail-closed discovery — auto only classifies canonical GeoServices URLs, everything else needs an explicit protocol.
